*Winner, 2020 PRISM Award* 

He's rich, sexy—and part-fae. 
But she's a shifter assassin on a mission. She can't let herself be charmed. 
Too bad fate isn't interested in playing fair... 

Marjani is the strong, silent second-in-command to her brother Adric, alpha of the Baltimore clan. She's seen too much death, lived through too much darkness. Now her cat threatens to take over, leaving her a cougar in a human body. But before it does, she undertakes one last mission to Iceland—to the heart of a treacherous fae court.

Fane holds a prestigious position as an envoy for the ice fae king, but the fae never let him forget he's not a pureblood. When he meets the beautiful shifter, everything he thought he wanted gets turned on its head. He'd sell his soul for a night with her.

Unfortunately, he just might have to...

"So many feels this book delivers..."~Uncaged Book Reviews 

NOTE: Charming Marjani is part of the Baltimore Earth Fada DarkTime Trilogy (along with Saving Jace and Adric's Heart). All books are standalone with an HEA, but the people, clans, and stories interconnect. If you crave dark shifters, dangerous fae, and intense emotional storylines, this series is for you.

Perfect for fans of:

• Fated mates

• Fae–shifter romance 

• Dangerous, charming heroes 

• Strong heroines 

• High heat romantasy 

• Magic, intrigue, and edge of your seat tension 

*BEST SHIFTER SERIES (Fada Shapeshifters) ~ Paranormal Romance Guild Reviewer's Choice Awards*
